Settings

General

Enabled
Replace fonts on all websites.
Excluded sites
One per line, e.g. example.com. Subdomains and embedded frames are included.

Fonts

Your browser's own font settings live on a separate page.

Monospace

Font size
Applied to code blocks. Editors are left alone.
px
Scaling
Shrinks named monospace fonts (Consolas, Menlo...) to match the browser's own monospace size.
%
Text boxes
Use the monospace font in <textarea>. Can misplace the cursor on sites that mirror their text boxes.

Code editors

Editors measure a character's width to place the cursor. Changing their font behind their back makes it drift.

Protect editors
No forced size or spacing inside them, and a font they already use is not swapped.
Learn fonts
Remember a monospace font an editor reveals late and apply it from the first paint after a reload.
Editor selectors
CSS selectors of editor containers, one per line. Add the root of any editor that still misbehaves. Individual ones can also be switched off from the toolbar popup.
Apply at page start
Replace these names before page scripts run, so editors measure your font from the start. Monospace fonts in Extra fonts are always included.
Back to the built-in list of well-known monospace fonts.

Extra fonts

For fonts that cannot be detected automatically, such as a font stack without a generic fallback. Use the name exactly as the site does.

Back to the built-in list of fonts.

Icon fonts

Protected keywords
A font whose name contains one of these words is never replaced. Built in: icon, awesome, glyph, symbol, emoji and more. One per line.

Settings file
Move your configuration to another browser.
Reset everything
Back to factory settings. You can undo it right after.

Import fonts

One font per line. Add a category after |: sans, serif, mono or ignore. Lines without one use the default below.
